description: Cross-language pin of the custom value chart constraint envelope (#524, #683). TS asserts it in packages/shared/src/chartGenerator.spec.ts against isValidChart; the Python SDK (jaiparera/pocketrocks-python-sdk#21) vendors this file and asserts its own validator against the same rows. Parity pins the VALIDATOR, not the RNG stream: each side keeps its own generator, only 'which charts are legal' must agree. Every reject row violates exactly ONE constraint, named in `reason`, so a validator that reports the violated constraint can be checked on the name too. Length short-circuits: the wrong_length rows keep their cells in range so no second constraint trips, the empty row excepted (no empty cell list reaches the sum floor), so report wrong_length on a bad length before checking cells, turns or sums.

accept.why: fixed chart A: monotone up, sum 60
fixed chart B: monotone down, sum 60
fixed chart C: monotone up, sum 50
fixed chart D: monotone down, sum 70
fixed chart E: hump, sum 38 -- exactly the floor; the envelope's global minimum
monotone exactly at the sum floor (38)
hump exactly at the sum floor (38)
legal valley: sum 82, trough 2 (inv-E from the #524 probe)
valley at both bounds: sum exactly 75, trough exactly 2
cells at both ends of [-cap, cap], sum 80
plateaus are not turning points: zero turns, sum 73
every cell at the cap, sum 120

reject.why: chart E minus one: hump, sum 37
hump one under the floor, sum 37
one cell below the cap (-21); sum 39 would otherwise pass
one cell far above the cap (40)
fractional cell (19.5): within the cap but not an integer -- isValidChart's cell test is Number.isInteger AND the bounds, so a range-only validator disagrees here
valley one under its floor: sum 74, trough 2
shallow valley with sum 46 -- would pass the monotone/hump floor
valley with sum exactly 75 but trough 0
seven cells; every cell in range, monotone, sum 78 -- length is the only constraint broken
no cells; the one row that cannot break exactly one constraint -- an empty chart can never reach the sum floor, so length must be checked first
